To account for these differences across languages, we propose Teachable On-Policy Self-Distillation (TOPSD), which determines where and whether teacher supervision should be applied to each reasoning trajectory. TOPSD uses teacher-student likelihood to estimate where drift begins and select a prefix for supervision. It then verifies whether the teacher can recover the correct answer from that prefix, applying distillation only to prefixes that pass verification. Experiments on multilingual mathematical reasoning across ten languages and three model scales show that TOPSD consistently outperforms conventional OPSD, particularly in low- and medium-resource languages.

ru.title: Учитель должен исправлять ошибки, а не копировать их
ru.desc: Статья посвящена улучшению многоязычного математического рассуждения у LLM с помощью On-Policy Self-Distillation, где модель-ученик обучается на собственных рассуждениях, а модель-учитель использует эталонные решения. Авторы выявили эффект Teacher Drift: при накоплении ошибок учитель начинает подражать неверным шагам ученика вместо их исправления, и это происходит раньше для языков с меньшими ресурсами. Предложенный метод TOPSD оценивает, где начинается дрейф, через правдоподобие учителя и ученика, выбирает префикс для супервизии и проверяет, способен ли учитель восстановить верный ответ, применяя дистилляцию только к прошедшим проверку префиксам. Эксперименты на десяти языках и трех масштабах моделей показывают, что TOPSD стабильно превосходит обычный OPSD, особенно для языков с низкими и средними ресурсами.

en.title: Stop Teacher Drift, Strengthen Multilingual Reasoning
en.desc: The paper studies on-policy self-distillation, where a student learns from its own reasoning with guidance from a teacher model. It identifies Teacher Drift: when the student makes mistakes, the teacher may copy those errors instead of correcting them, especially in lower-resource languages. The proposed Teachable On-Policy Self-Distillation (TOPSD) uses teacher-student likelihoods to detect where drift starts, then checks whether the teacher can reach the correct answer from the selected reasoning prefix. Across ten languages and three model scales, TOPSD outperforms conventional self-distillation, with especially strong gains in low- and medium-resource languages.

zh.title: 识别教师漂移，让多语言自蒸馏更会纠错
zh.desc: 本文研究如何用在线策略自蒸馏提升多语言数学推理能力：学生模型学习自己的推理过程，并由同一模型充当教师提供指导。作者发现“教师漂移”现象，即学生推理中的错误逐渐累积时，教师可能会顺着错误继续，而非纠正错误；这种情况在低资源语言中出现得更早。为此，作者提出可教式在线策略自蒸馏（TOPSD），通过教师与学生的似然值估计漂移起点，选取推理前缀，并检验教师能否从该前缀恢复正确答案。只有通过检验的前缀才用于蒸馏；在涵盖十种语言和三种模型规模的实验中，TOPSD 整体优于传统 OPSD，尤其提升了低资源和中资源语言的表现。

papers.title: OneTrans-GSR: A Generative Slate Ranking Paradigm Unifying Reranking and Mix-Ranking with One Autoregressive Transformer
papers.abstract: Abstract  Industrial recommender systems allocate substantial computation to pointwise candidate scoring, yet separate reranking and mix-ranking stages still assemble the final exposure slate using hand-crafted rules and specialized low-capacity models. Mix-ranking combines product cards, short videos, livestreams, and advertising cards supplied by distinct upstream business channels. Although these rules and models encode valuable domain knowledge, they are inherently limited in leveraging additional data and computation. They constrain the combinatorial space of candidate slates and determine objective trade-offs through manual tuning. To enable scalable and effective slate generation, we reformulate reranking and mix-ranking as a unified learning problem whose performance can improve with computation. Specifically, we instantiate this formulation across the reranking and mix-ranking stages and propose OneTrans-GSR, a single decoder-only policy that extends our deployed OneTrans backbone to generate the exposure slate end-to-end. During training, a reward model evaluates complete slates and guides reinforcement learning toward slate-level and long-term objectives. During decoding, business constraints are explicitly enforced. Offline evaluation shows that slate quality consistently improves as reward-model and policy compute increase. Deployed in a large-scale industrial recommendation system, OneTrans-GSR mixes heterogeneous content types within a unified slate. In online A/B tests, it improves GMV/u by 2.63%, advertiser value by 2.06%, and repurchase rate by 2.03%, while reducing end-to-end latency across the reranking and mix-ranking stages by 13%. These results mark a paradigm shift in slate generation: moving beyond human-engineered heuristics toward a general learned policy creates a scalable path for further algorithmic optimization and compute-driven improvement.

ru.title: От ручных правил к обучаемой политике: список показа, который растет вместе с вычислениями
ru.desc: Промышленные рекомендательные системы тратят много вычислений на поточечную оценку кандидатов, но финальный список показа формируется вручную заданными правилами и отдельными слабыми моделями. Авторы предлагают единую обучаемую задачу для реранкинга и mix-ranking, а их модель OneTrans-GSR, построенная на decoder-only архитектуре, генерирует весь список показа целиком. Во время обучения reward model оценивает готовые списки, и reinforcement learning оптимизирует их на уровне всего слейта и долгосрочных целей, а при декодировании явно учитываются бизнес-ограничения. В онлайн A/B тестах модель повысила GMV/u на 2.63% и снизила сквозную задержку на 13%.

en.title: Learn the Whole Slate, Improve with More Compute
en.desc: The paper treats reranking and mix-ranking as one learning problem: choosing an entire slate of products, videos, livestreams, and ads. It introduces OneTrans-GSR, a decoder-only policy that generates the slate end-to-end, while a reward model guides reinforcement learning toward slate-level and long-term goals. Business constraints are enforced during decoding, and offline results show that slate quality improves as more computation is used for the reward model and policy. In online tests, the system increased GMV per user, advertiser value, and repurchase rate, while reducing latency by 13%.

zh.title: 告别手工规则，让计算驱动推荐列表持续进化
zh.desc: 这篇论文把推荐系统中的重排和混排统一建模为一个可学习的序列生成问题，并提出只用一个解码器策略端到端生成最终曝光列表的 OneTrans-GSR。训练时，奖励模型评估完整列表，并通过强化学习优化列表级和长期目标；生成时，模型会显式遵守业务约束。离线实验显示，增加奖励模型和策略的计算量能持续提升列表质量；线上测试中，GMV/u、广告主价值和复购率分别提升 2.63%、2.06% 和 2.03%，同时端到端延迟降低 13%。这项工作以通用学习策略取代手工规则和低容量专用模型，为扩大计算量、持续优化推荐列表提供了新路径。

papers.title: OmniLatent: Unified Latent for 3D Part Modeling
papers.abstract: Abstract OmniLatent jointly encodes geometry, deformation, appearance, and part identifiers in a shared latent space to generate and interactively edit part-aware 3D assets from a single image, including segmentation, refinement, subdivision, and amodal completion.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 3D part decomposition is a central capability for editable asset creation, yet existing workflows typically segment a completed mesh as a post-processing step, making the result sensitive to geometric artifacts, texture ambiguity, and limited part-level annotations. We present OmniLatent, a unified latent modeling framework for 3D part decomposition. Instead of predicting part labels in isolation, OmniLatent learns a shared latent space that jointly encodes geometry, deformation, appearance, and binary part IDs, allowing data-rich geometric and visual priors to support data-scarce part learning. Given a single input image, the base model generates geometry, deformation, texture, and surface part IDs in one pass, producing a part-aware 3D asset without a separate segmentation stage. We further tune the pretrained model for two extensions: a point-prompt adapter that maps arbitrary 3D point prompts with binary part IDs into latent tokens for full segmentation, refinement, and part subdivision, and an amodal part completion model that completes partial surface masks into a coherent full-object decomposition through dynamic per-part token allocation, cross-attention to the given geometry latent, and alternating part-local and global attention. Extensive experiments show that OmniLatent produces semantically meaningful part segmentations with precise boundaries, supports interactive part editing, and completes partial part observations while preserving global object consistency.
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

ru.title: Части 3D-объекта рождаются вместе с самим объектом из одного изображения
ru.desc: OmniLatent — это единая латентная модель для декомпозиции 3D-объектов на части, которая совместно кодирует геометрию, деформацию, внешний вид и бинарные ID частей в общем латентном пространстве. Модель генерирует 3D-ассет с частями по одному изображению за один проход, без отдельного этапа сегментации уже готового меша. Адаптер на основе 3D-точек-промптов и модель amodal-дополнения частей, использующая динамическое выделение токенов и чередующееся внимание, позволяют сегментировать, уточнять, subdivide и достраивать неполные маски. Эксперименты показывают точные границы частей, семантическую осмысленность и сохранение глобальной согласованности объекта.

en.title: One Shared Latent Space for 3D Assets You Can Understand and Edit
en.desc: OmniLatent is a unified latent model that represents 3D geometry, deformation, appearance, and part IDs together. From a single image, it generates a textured 3D asset with part segmentation in one pass, rather than segmenting the mesh afterward. A point-prompt adapter supports segmentation, refinement, and subdivision, while an amodal completion model predicts unseen parts from partial masks. Experiments show that it creates meaningful part boundaries and supports interactive editing while maintaining consistency across the object.

zh.title: 在统一潜空间中生成、分解并编辑 3D 部件
zh.desc: OmniLatent 是一个统一的 3D 潜变量建模框架，可从单张图像生成带有部件信息的 3D 模型。它在共享潜空间中联合编码几何形状、形变、外观和部件标识，因此无需先生成模型再单独进行分割。研究还提供点提示适配器，可用于部件分割、细化和拆分，并能将不完整的部件标记补全为完整且连贯的对象分解。实验表明，该方法能生成边界精确、语义合理的部件，支持交互式编辑，并保持整体形状的一致性。

papers.title: The Last Mile to the Real World: Agent-Native Primitives as Reusable Building Blocks for Solving Real-World Tasks
papers.abstract: Abstract  How can an agent handle a real-world task end to end? Frontier models with their own harnesses still fall short on real-world benchmarks: on Terminal-Bench 4.0, GPT-5.6 Sol with Codex resolves 37.3% of the tasks and Claude Opus 5 with Claude Code 51.8%. These tasks fail at the step from reaching a resource to applying it, which we call the last mile to the real world. Existing approaches put the resource within reach but leave the competence to apply it with the caller, so each harness rebuilds that competence. We introduce agent-native primitives, reusable units that equip a resource with a resident LLM that applies it in context and communicates with other primitives, and HEELO (Harness Engineering around Evolving Agent-Native Primitives for the Last Mile to Real-WOrld Tasks), a harness engineering framework that builds each task's harness from a library of such primitives. HEELO composes the primitives a task needs into a task-specific graph, verifies the result against evidence from the environment, revises the primitives a failure implicates, and admits new or improved primitives after validation. We instantiate HEELO with eight primitive families, each built for one kind of task, and evaluate them on more than twenty benchmarks. Dev-Primitives raise Terminal-Bench 4.0 resolution from 37.3% under Codex to 55.5% on the same backbone, Harness Primitives composed per task raise Terminal-Bench 2.0 Pass@1 from 60.0% for the seed harness to 72.2%, Tool Primitives raise ToolBench pass rate from 55.8% to 75.1%, and Navigation Primitives raise GAIA-Text-103 accuracy from 45.6% to 58.3%. On the 46 real-world tasks of our heelo.dev platform, Claude Opus 5.5 with Claude Code and GPT-6.1 Sol with Codex complete 9 each on their own and 39 and 35 when connected to HEELO through our MCP server, with 1.9times and 2.3times less time and 1.55times lower cost per completed task.

ru.title: Агент, который доводит реальную задачу до конца, собирая свой harness из примитивов
ru.desc: Статья показывает, что современные LLM-агенты плохо справляются с реальными задачами, потому что не умеют применять найденные ресурсы, и предлагает HEELO, фреймворк инженерии harness. Он собирает harness под каждую задачу из библиотеки agent-native primitives, то есть переиспользуемых модулей, где каждому ресурсу приставлена резидентная LLM. Система строит граф примитивов, проверяет результат по данным среды, пересматривает проблемные примитивы и добавляет валидированные новые. Эксперименты на более чем двадцати бенчмарках и на платформе heelo.dev показывают заметный рост качества, скорости и снижение стоимости выполнения задач.

en.title: Give AI agents the skills to take the last mile
en.desc: The paper introduces agent-native primitives: reusable components that pair a resource with an LLM capable of using it and coordinating with other components. HEELO builds a task-specific harness by connecting relevant primitives into a graph, checking results against evidence from the environment, and improving primitives when failures reveal weaknesses. Across more than twenty benchmarks, this approach improves task completion in software development, tool use, navigation, and other settings. On real-world tasks, connecting existing AI agents to HEELO substantially increases completed tasks while reducing time and cost per task.

zh.title: 让每种资源自带会使用它的智能体，打通真实任务最后一公里
zh.desc: 现实任务常常不是找不到资源，而是找到资源后，代理仍不会正确使用它，这就是通往真实世界的“最后一公里”。论文提出“智能体原生原语”：每个可复用单元都带有常驻大语言模型，能在具体情境中操作资源，并与其他原语协作。基于此，HEELO 会为任务组合专属原语图，根据环境证据检查结果，并在失败后改进相关原语。实验显示，这种方法在多项基准测试和真实任务中提升了完成率，同时减少完成任务所需的时间与成本。

papers.title: Sketchpad: certified exact arithmetic with a small vision-language model
papers.abstract: Abstract  Language models are accurate on most long-arithmetic problems, but their accuracy is estimated on samples and carries no guarantee for an unseen input; tool use is exact but moves the computation outside the network. We show that exactness at all input lengths becomes a finite, checkable property of a network when each of its steps reads only a bounded view of an external working memory. In Sketchpad, Qwen3.5-0.8B with a low-rank adapter executes arithmetic procedures on a rendered sheet. Each forward pass reads a three-cell view and emits one step: a digit, a carry or borrow, and the next operation. A fixed runtime moves the view and writes no digit of a result. We prove in Lean that the model is then exact on all inputs of any length if and only if it is exact on the finite set of views the runtime presents, that no finite test suffices when steps also read earlier steps, and that the guarantee tolerates bounded numerical perturbation and extends to compositions of procedures. All 2,446 views pass on the deployment device, a laptop GPU running the model in a web browser. The certified model performs signed addition and subtraction, long multiplication and division, square roots and greatest common divisors at arbitrary length. It solved 200 of 200 pre-registered problems in the browser, and 220 of 220 sums of up to 1,000 digits and products of up to 20 digits, of which GPT-6.1 Sol, the strongest of ten other models, solved 217. A symbolic runtime built on these procedures solves, expands and factors polynomials with every number computed by the model, and a multiplicative gate on the adapter recovers the base model exactly when the sheet is not in use.

ru.title: Точная арифметика на любой длине: проверяемость вместо надежды на выборку
ru.desc: Авторы предлагают Sketchpad: языковая модель (LLM) Qwen3.5-0.8B с low-rank адаптером выполняет арифметические процедуры на внешнем «листе», читая на каждом шаге лишь ограниченное окно из трёх ячеек. Они доказывают в Lean, что точность модели на входах любой длины эквивалентна её корректности на конечном наборе проверяемых окон, что делает свойство точности верифицируемым. Гарантия устойчива к ограниченным численным возмущениям и распространяется на композиции процедур, а модель работает прямо в браузере на ноутбуке. На тестах она превосходит значительно более крупные модели, включая GPT-6.1 Sol, в операциях над длинными числами.

en.title: Prove Every View, Solve Arithmetic at Any Length
en.desc: The paper presents Sketchpad, a language model system that performs arithmetic by reading a small, fixed-size view of an external working memory and emitting one step at a time. The authors prove in Lean that the system is correct for inputs of any length if and only if it passes a finite set of runtime-generated views, provided each step cannot read earlier steps. They verify all 2,446 possible views and report strong results on long arithmetic, including problems with numbers up to 1,000 digits. The approach also supports composing arithmetic procedures and polynomial operations, while a gate lets the adapted model behave exactly like its original base model when the working sheet is unused.

zh.title: 把无限长度的算术精确性，化为有限视图的可验证保证
zh.desc: 本文提出 Sketchpad，让语言模型通过读取外部工作表上的有限局部视图，逐步执行算术过程。模型每一步只读取三个单元格，并输出数字、进位或借位以及下一步操作；固定运行时负责移动视图和写入结果数字。作者在 Lean 中证明，只要模型在运行时可能呈现的所有有限视图上都正确，它就能对任意长度输入保持精确；若步骤还读取先前步骤，则有限测试无法提供同样保证。该方法还支持对数值扰动的容忍和过程组合，并在浏览器中通过了全部 2,446 个视图的检查，可执行任意长度的多种算术运算。

papers.title: Learning to evolve by matching velocities
papers.abstract: Abstract Velocity Matching is a simulation-free objective for learning continuous-time dynamics that avoids long-rollout instability and numerical-scheme bias while providing theoretical guarantees and improved accuracy on ODEs and PDEs.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Learning the continuous-time evolution of nonlinear dynamical systems relies on trajectory-based objectives, which require simulating the learned dynamics during training and backpropagating through the numerical scheme, at a cost that grows with the rollout horizon. We show that trajectory-based objectives degenerate as the rollout horizon increases, hindering gradient-based optimization, and that the numerical scheme biases the learned dynamics by constraining the spectrum of the learned Jacobian to its absolute stability region. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Velocity Matching (VM), a simulation-free objective that relies on piecewise-linear interpolation and stochastic collocation, and approximates the velocity population risk to second order in the sampling step. We develop a theoretical framework for velocity-based learning, introducing stability estimates that control trajectory errors in terms of velocity errors, which enable us to establish universal and continuous-time approximation results when the learned velocity field is parameterized by deep neural networks. Building on a bias-variance decomposition of the VM objective, we show that its higher-order approximation of the velocity population risk yields a consistent minimizer; that it relates to the residual of an A-stable continuous-stage Runge-Kutta scheme, thus connecting VM to implicit integration without requiring any implicit solve; and that it implicitly matches the action of the learned Jacobian to that of the true one along the observed trajectories, without requiring access to the underlying velocity field or its Jacobian. Numerical experiments on nonlinear ordinary differential equations and semi-discretized time-dependent partial differential equations show that VM improves accuracy over trajectory-based objectives, while avoiding both the cost of simulation and the instabilities of long rollouts.

ru.title: Учим скорость, а не траекторию: динамика без симуляции
ru.desc: В статье предлагается Velocity Matching (VM) — метод обучения непрерывной динамики без симуляции, который устраняет проблемы траекторных целевых функций: нестабильность на длинных горизонтах и смещение, вносимое численной схемой. VM использует кусочно-линейную интерполяцию и стохастическую коллокацию, аппроксимируя популяционный риск по скорости со вторым порядком по шагу выборки. Авторы доказывают устойчивостные оценки и универсальные аппроксимационные свойства для глубоких нейронных сетей, а также связь с неявными A-устойчивыми схемами Рунге–Кутты. Эксперименты на нелинейных ОДУ и полудискретизированных нестационарных PDE показывают улучшение точности без дорогостоящих симуляций и нестабильностей длинных роллаутов.

en.title: Learn Dynamics Directly—No Long Rollouts Required
en.desc: Velocity Matching (VM) learns continuous-time dynamics without simulating long trajectories during training. It uses piecewise-linear interpolation and stochastic collocation to estimate velocity errors, avoiding numerical-scheme bias and the instability of long rollouts. The paper provides theoretical guarantees linking velocity accuracy to trajectory accuracy and shows that VM can consistently learn dynamics represented by deep neural networks. Experiments on ordinary and partial differential equations show improved accuracy compared with trajectory-based objectives, at lower simulation cost.

zh.title: 免模拟学习动力学：速度匹配兼得精度与稳定
zh.desc: 本文提出速度匹配（Velocity Matching，VM）目标，用于学习连续时间动力系统，无需在训练中模拟轨迹或反向传播通过数值求解过程。研究指出，长时间轨迹训练会使优化退化，而数值积分方法还可能对学到的动力学产生偏差。VM结合分段线性插值与随机配置点，以较高阶精度近似速度的总体风险，并给出了速度误差如何控制轨迹误差的理论保证。实验表明，在常微分方程和偏微分方程任务中，VM比轨迹目标更准确，同时避免了长程模拟的成本与不稳定性。

papers.title: Where to Connect? Boosting MLLMs via Dynamic Gated Pathways across ALL ViT and LLM Layers
papers.abstract: Abstract Dynamic Gated Pathways connects every vision transformer layer to every large language model layer and lets each LLM layer dynamically gate its preferred visual granularity, yielding consistent multimodal gains over LLaVA-1.5 baselines.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash A central yet under-explored question in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is where to connect---how visual information from a hierarchical vision encoder should be wired into the layer-wise semantics of a large language model. Mainstream MLLMs inject a fixed single-layer visual representation into the LLM and treat all LLM layers as a single consumer, ignoring that different layers demand different visual granularities. Recent multi-layer fusion methods either compress hierarchical features on the encoder side or rely on predefined sparse or hierarchical layer-to-layer connections, and therefore stop short of modeling adaptive cross-layer interactions between the ViT and LLM hierarchies. We address this gap with DGP (Dynamic Gated Pathways), a routing mechanism that establishes all-to-all connections between every ViT layer and every LLM layer, with each LLM layer dynamically gating its preference over visual layers conditioned on its own semantic state. Built on top of LLaVA-1.5-7B and 13B, DGP delivers consistent gains over the LLaVA-1.5-7B baseline (e.g., +4.2 on SQA^{I}, +3.3 on MM-Vet, +3.1 on VizWiz and LLaVA^{W}) and surpasses prior multi-layer visual fusion methods on most benchmarks. Layer-wise routing analyses further show that different LLM layers do select different visual granularities on demand, supporting both the effectiveness and interpretability of the proposed dynamic gated pathways. The code is available: https://github.com/YingyingYan1/DGP.
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, Hong Kong, China

ru.title: Каждый слой LLM сам выбирает, какие визуальные признаки ему нужны
ru.desc: В статье предлагается DGP (Dynamic Gated Pathways), механизм маршрутизации, который соединяет каждый слой vision transformer с каждым слоем LLM. Каждый слой языковой модели динамически выбирает, какие уровни визуальных признаков использовать, опираясь на своё текущее семантическое состояние. Метод построен на LLaVA-1.5 (7B и 13B) и даёт стабильный прирост качества на нескольких мультимодальных бенчмарках. Анализ маршрутизации показывает, что разные слои LLM действительно выбирают разную визуальную детализацию, что подтверждает эффективность и интерпретируемость подхода.

en.title: Let Every Language Layer Choose the Vision It Needs
en.desc: Dynamic Gated Pathways (DGP) improves how a multimodal large language model connects visual and language information. It links every vision transformer layer to every language-model layer, rather than giving all language layers the same visual features. Each language layer uses a learned gate, based on its own semantic state, to select the visual layers and granularity it needs. Tests on LLaVA-1.5 models show consistent benchmark gains, while routing analyses reveal that different language layers choose different visual features.

zh.title: 让语言模型各层按需选择视觉信息
zh.desc: 多模态大语言模型需要决定视觉编码器的哪些层应与语言模型的哪些层相连。本文提出动态门控通路（DGP），将视觉Transformer的每一层连接到大型语言模型的每一层。每个语言模型层根据自身语义状态，动态选择并融合所需的视觉特征粒度。实验显示，DGP在多个基准测试上优于LLaVA-1.5及多数既有多层视觉融合方法，分析也表明不同语言模型层确实会选择不同的视觉信息。

papers.title: Static Recovery Is Not Dynamic Stability: Dynamics-Aware Benchmarking of Protein Motif Scaffolding
papers.abstract: Abstract New benchmarks and molecular dynamics frameworks are presented to rigorously evaluate protein scaffold-generation models by assessing dynamic fidelity and structural stability beyond static success.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Protein motif scaffolding benchmarks assess whether generative models can build scaffolds around functionally important residues. Their conclusions depend on which motifs are tested and which criteria define success. Existing benchmarks typically use small hand-curated motif sets and static refolding criteria, but protein function often depends on conformational ensembles and transitions. Here, we address both benchmark scope and success criteria. We introduce BILBY-PRO, a systematically derived benchmark of structurally conserved functional motifs from PROSITE-linked experimental structures, comprising 220 cases from 174 PROSITE motif-pattern entries. Evaluating six recent scaffold-generation models reveals distinct patterns in target coverage and unique-solution yield: RFDiffusion and Proteina solve more targets, whereas ESM3 produces more unique successful scaffolds on the targets it solves. We further introduce BILBY-MD, a reference-based all-atom molecular dynamics evaluation framework. Applied to statically solved designs from the original MotifBench benchmark, it compares motif drift, scaffold drift, motif-contact preservation, and motif-dihedral free-energy landscapes against reference simulations. Of 55 statically solved model-problem pairs, 31 satisfy our MD-supported criterion and only 8 pass all checks. Compact, self-contained motifs are often MD-supported, whereas interface-like or context-dependent motifs fail more frequently. Static refolding success therefore provides useful evidence of local motif recovery but does not establish dynamical fidelity of the full scaffold. BILBY highlights three complementary axes of motif-scaffolding evaluation: target coverage, unique-solution yield, and MD-supported dynamical fidelity.

ru.title: Статический успех не гарантирует динамическую стабильность белкового каркаса
ru.desc: В статье представлены два новых инструмента для оценки генеративных моделей, которые строят белковые каркасы вокруг функционально важных мотивов. BILBY-PRO — это систематически собранный бенчмарк из 220 случаев на основе экспериментальных структур, связанных с PROSITE, по которому оценивались шесть современных моделей, включая RFDiffusion, Proteina и ESM3. BILBY-MD — это референсный фреймворк для молекулярной динамики all-atom, который сравнивает дрейф мотива и каркаса, сохранение контактов и свободную энергию относительно эталонных симуляций. Результаты показывают, что успешность статического рефолдинга лишь частично отражает динамическую достоверность: из 55 статически успешных решений только 8 прошли все проверки.

en.title: Beyond Static Success: Test Protein Scaffolds in Motion
en.desc: The paper introduces BILBY-PRO, a benchmark of 220 protein motif-scaffolding tasks, and BILBY-MD, a molecular dynamics framework for testing whether generated scaffolds remain stable and preserve motif behavior over time. Comparing six generation models shows that RFDiffusion and Proteina solve more targets, while ESM3 produces more distinct successful designs on the targets it solves. Of 55 designs that passed static refolding tests, 31 also met the study’s molecular-dynamics criterion, and only 8 passed every check. The results show that static structure recovery alone cannot establish dynamical fidelity, so scaffold models should be evaluated by target coverage, unique-solution yield, and dynamic stability.

zh.title: 从静态折叠到动态保真：全面检验蛋白支架生成
zh.desc: 本文提出 BILBY-PRO 基准，用 220 个功能性蛋白质基序案例，系统评估模型能否围绕关键残基生成支架。对六种模型的比较显示，RFDiffusion 和 Proteina 覆盖的目标更多，而 ESM3 在成功解决的目标上生成了更多独特支架。研究还提出 BILBY-MD 框架，通过全原子分子动力学模拟评估基序与支架的偏移、接触保持情况，以及基序二面角的自由能景观。结果表明，静态折叠成功并不代表动态稳定或功能保真，因此支架生成应同时考察目标覆盖率、独特解产出和动态保真度。
